column1: # Search keywords of the SUPER+/ menu and the reading page: regex <TAB> words. A row gets the words when the regex (case-insensitive,
# re.search) matches its DESCRIPTION (never the block title: a title would hand the words to every row of the block), so "screen
# shot" finds the "Screenshot ..." binds and "password" finds the Bitwarden pickers. Anchor the regexes (\bword\b, ^start): `keymap
# check` fails on a rule that hits more than 60 rows or every row of a block of 8 or more. The words are searched next to keys,
# description and block (the row shows only the description). Every regex must match at least one row (`keymap check` fails on a stale rule); add a line when a natural word finds nothing.
